breaking.change: A menu entry's words, line and chevron take the pack's `MenuList.label`, `MenuList.label.md`, `MenuList.line` and `MenuList.chevron` slots, and the current entry also draws the pack's `MenuList.cursor`, instead of fixed classes.
breaking.fix: An ejected menu list writes `packClass("MenuList", "label")` and the other slots in place of its own type classes.

added.summary: A titled panel control (`@origingame/engine/ui/controls/panel`): the pack's frame, its inside room (`Panel.body`) and its heading (`Panel.title`, the words or the band they sit on).
